hero.description1: Software Engineer with 2+ years of experience in building and shipping production-grade mobile (Flutter) and backend (Python, .NET) applications.
hero.description2: Passionate about architecting scalable systems and end-to-end solutions, leveraging advanced architectural research, hands-on deep learning model design and fine-tuning, and software methodologies to deliver high-performance, robust industrial applications.

job1.r1: Developed and enhanced backend services with FastAPI for a multi-tenant enterprise platform and its administrative dashboard.
job1.r2: Reduced dashboard load times from 5 seconds to under 1 second via query optimization, server-side pagination, database indexing, and Redis caching.
job1.r3: Improved system reliability and scalability by addressing database locking and query performance issues, preventing dashboard freezes during peak enterprise traffic.
job1.r4: Implemented silent JWT token refresh to keep sessions alive during lengthy passport-scanning operations.

job2.role: Researcher Scholar (TÜBİTAK 1001 Project Founded) — Mobile Application Developer
job2.r1: Built a high-performance Flutter app for real-time location tracking and live monitoring, with Google Maps visualization and multithreaded processing of live IoT data streams over WebSocket.
job2.r2: Engineered resilient background services that kept the app stable and synchronized under sustained heavy workloads.
job2.r3: Designed an offline-first communication layer: BLE-based peer-to-peer group chat with E2EE and known-contact group management, plus a localization/orientation module using Bluetooth RSSI and magnetometer data.
job2.r4: Trained and optimized lightweight deep learning models for mobile deployment, converting them to TensorFlow Lite and integrating them for efficient real-time on-device inference.

job3.r1: Designed and delivered TurVia, an end-to-end smart tourism and tour-management platform, from initial architecture through production deployment on Google Play and the App Store.

job4.r1: Developed a Flutter mobile application with biometric authentication, including MRZ and NFC passport/ID.
job4.r2: Developed FastAPI backend services for biometric data processing, identity verification, and real-time validation.
job4.r3: Contributed to a multi-tenant administration dashboard for centralized user, operation, and system-log monitoring.
job4.r4: Integrated mobile, backend, and computer-vision components to support secure and reliable identity verification workflows.

p1.title: TurVia — Smart Tourism & Navigation

p2.title: KURTAR — IoT & AI-Based Disaster Response App
p2.description: Developed the Flutter app end-to-end, integrating Google Maps for real-time incident visualization, and built an offline-first BLE layer featuring E2EE 1-to-1 and group messaging, RSSI/magnetometer localization, role-based access, and pre-incident health profiles to expedite rescue operations. Co-trained lightweight models (CNN, LSTM, GNN) with PyTorch on time-series IoT and mobile sensor data, then converted and deployed them via TensorFlow Lite for on-device real-time disaster decision support.

p3.title: Kurtar Saha — Field Data & AI Suite

p4.description: A secure digital onboarding SDK for iOS & Android with high-fidelity camera capture, Liveness Detection, Face Matching algorithms, NFC/MRZ document reading, and a centralized dashboard for real-time administrative oversight.

p5.title: IbanVault — Secure IBAN Manager
p5.description: Offline-first Flutter app for encrypted IBAN storage with QR code generation & scanning, multi-language support (EN/TR/AR), RTL-aware layouts, and AES-encrypted local database. Clean MVC architecture with Provider.

p6.title: Vakit — Smart Prayer Times App
p6.description: A multilingual Islamic prayer times app with GPS-based & manual city selection, 3 saved cities, timely local notifications, customizable reminders, and RTL-aware UI available in Turkish, English, and Arabic.

p7.title: LenDeX — Smart Lending UI
p7.description: A high-fidelity Flutter UI kit for personal budgeting and micro-lending app designs. Featuring pixel-perfect layouts, responsive dashboard components, interactive charts, and smooth animation transitions.

p8.title: AI Financial — Visually Impaired (Thesis)
p8.description: Undergraduate graduation thesis awarded with Honours. A YOLOv5-powered mobile app providing real-time money recognition and full financial management for visually impaired users, backed by Firebase and intelligent accessibility design.

p9.title: NetGuard — LAN Security Analyzer
p9.description: A Flutter app for non-intrusive LAN network analysis and connected device discovery. Uses an Evidence Scoring engine that combines open ports, response time, and MAC address data to classify devices by risk level. Built with Clean Architecture, MVVM (Provider), and Dart Isolates for parallel scanning without blocking the UI.

pharma.title: Pharma
